story.value: Mercury is named after the Roman god Mercury, the nimble messenger of the gods.
The symbol Hg comes from the Greek word hydrargyrum, meaning "liquid silver" or "quick silver".
Mercury was known to the ancient Chinese and Hindus.

uses.value: Mercury can be used to make thermometers, barometers and other scientific instruments.
Mercury vapor is used in streetlights, fluorescent lamps and advertising signs.
Mercury conducts electricity and is used to make silent switches that depend on their position.
Mercury alloys called amalgams are used for things such as dental fillings.
